issues.desc: background.md Key Insights paragraph uses `MIN_ARM_N=20` without any definition or context ("cannot accrue toward MIN_ARM_N=20"). A standalone reader with no conversation history cannot tell what this constant represents, where it lives, or its role in the A/B learning-effectiveness system. At minimum, one sentence should define it (e.g., "minimum samples per arm required before declaring statistical significance, defined in core/learning-effectiveness.ts").
